v.v: I received the strawberry and milk chocolate chip cookies. I gave half of them to my SIL, who is also postpartum. They were fresh, soft and delicious! … I think these would be lovely to gift a new Mum…
Sweet, soft oat cookies that are seriously addictive—and perfect for a lactating mum who’s constantly hungry. … The cookies are generously sized, so one was usually enough to keep me full.
I was gifted these lactation cookies right after giving birth … They were such a comforting treat during those early postpartum days and made me feel really supported as a new mum.
